defects: The father (Abdeslem) is wedged stiffly upright behind the boy and the right woman instead of bending to set the boy on the ground.
The boy's left shoulder clips into the left woman's white haik.
The souk alley is completely empty despite the beat describing a crowd.
tiles.fix: Pose the father crouching or leaning forward with hands on the boy's shoulders as he sets him down, and separate the boy slightly from the left woman's haik.

defects: The father remains frozen upright behind the boy and the right woman with his grey djellaba hem poking out between their robes, neither setting the boy down nor moving away.
No crowd is present in the alley for the father to disappear into.
tiles.fix: Animate the father turning and striding away down the souk alley away from the family.

defects: The father pops out of existence in an completely empty corridor rather than disappearing behind a crowd.
Both women and the boy remain frozen in identical mannequin poses from the previous two beats.
tiles.fix: Have the women and boy turn their heads anxiously down the alley where the father exited, and add crowd figures in the midground obstructing the view.

defects: Severe mesh clipping on the left woman (Lalla Aicha): her dark inner garment/arm pokes through the front chest of her white haik, and dark hair/cloth clips through the veil around her forehead and eyes.
Her pose barely reacts to having her feet trampled—she only tilts slightly in an empty alley.
tiles.fix: Fix the cloth/body skinning on the left woman's haik and pose her hunching down with one foot lifted or reaching toward her hurt feet.

defects: Same severe mesh penetration on the left woman's chest and forehead where dark inner meshes pierce the white haik.
The right woman and boy stand rigidly like mannequins without reacting to the stampede or to Lalla Aicha's cry.
tiles.fix: Repair the left woman's haik mesh penetration and turn the boy and right woman toward her in alarm.

defects: Catastrophic mesh tearing on the central woman's head and upper chest: her black hair, hands, and face veil clip violently through the white haik geometry.
The woman on the left edge is sliced vertically in half by the frame border and also has dark hair clipping through her brow veil.
A tiny background figure on the right is underscaled against the shop wall.
tiles.fix: Fix the haik rig/cloth collision around the central woman's head and hands so she visibly clutches her dishevelled haik without geometry tearing, and reframe to avoid cutting the left woman in half.

defects: The central woman's head, hair, and hands are still badly intersecting and tearing through the top of her white haik.
The left woman remains bisected by the left edge of the frame, and the underscaled background child on the right persists.
tiles.fix: Clean up the central woman's head/haik mesh intersections and adjust the crop slightly left to include or cleanly clear the left woman.

defects: In the background right, the father and the dellal are not grabbing each other by the collar ('se tenant mutuellement par le collet')—their hands hover in front of their own chests.
The second woman in a white haik is inexplicably separated from the mother and boy, standing far down the alley on the right partially blocking the fighters.
tiles.fix: Keep both women together in the foreground left with the boy, and pose the father and dellal with extended arms gripping each other's collars.

defects: The father and the dellal stand in the middle of the alley with forearms raised vertically like a patty-cake gesture rather than gripping each other's collars.
The father is still wearing his white turban, contradicting beat s14 38.3 where he has already lost it.
The second woman remains stranded down the alley on the right.
tiles.fix: Extend both men's arms so their hands visibly grasp the opponent's collar, remove the father's turban, and group the second woman with the family on the left.

defects: Neither man is holding the other's collar: their hands are tucked against their own chins/chests.
The father still wears his white turban on his head right before the beat showing it lost on the ground.
The camera is too wide and profile-angled to read the red eyes and foam at the lips described in the line.
tiles.fix: Zoom in closer on the two men's faces in three-quarter view, remove the father's turban, and lock their fists onto each other's collars.

defects: The lost turban on the ground looks like a flat cutout with three black holes in the mesh and lacks ground integration.
Awkward framing cuts the boy at the waist on the left and crops the fighters to two pairs of floating yellow-slippered feet at the top edge.
tiles.fix: Remodel the fallen turban as unwrapped folds of white cloth resting on the floor, and tilt/widen the camera slightly so the men's lower legs and ground contact read clearly.

defects: Broken character scale on the crowd ('tout le souk leur faisait cortège'): the four followers in the alley are scaled down to the height of the 6-year-old boy, looking like a row of small children.
The fighting father and dellal are completely hidden behind the four tiny followers.
tiles.fix: Scale the adult crowd followers up to full adult height (matching the women and father), stagger their positions, and keep the taller father and dellal visible ahead of them.

defects: The four followers in the cortège remain shrunk to child scale, matching the boy's height rather than adult proportions.
The father and dellal remain completely occluded behind the miniature crowd row, and all characters stand in stiff, static rear poses.
tiles.fix: Restore adult scale to the following crowd figures and add walking/jostling poses with the father and dellal visible at the front of the procession.

worst_problem: Severe cloth-and-body mesh tearing on the women's white haiks (beats 17.3–21.8) combined with broken child-sized scaling on the adult crowd following the fight (beats 43.0–44.3) and missing collar-grabbing contact between the father and the dellal.
